plan.notes: Source: Samaritan Hospital School of Nursing 2025-2027 Catalog (St. Peter's Health Partners), official 'COURSE SEQUENCE FOR ASSOCIATE DEGREE PROGRAM', transcribed exactly: four semesters (16/16/16/16) = 64 credits total. The catalog states 'Graduates earn a two-year Associate of Science degree' (AS), eligible for the NCLEX-RN; 34 nursing credit hours + 30 corequisite credit hours = 64. Corequisite courses (marked *) are 'usually taken at Hudson Valley Community College' (University at Albany or Siena College for those students); corequisite course codes are sequence labels since the catalog publishes names only. Elective slots transcribed as choice courses. Prerequisite chains from the course descriptions were not transcribed: the NSGV course description names a 'Nursing III' prerequisite that does not appear in the published course sequence (an apparent catalog artifact), so prereqs are omitted rather than transcribed ambiguously; semester order is as published. No courses invented.
